newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian airport sale to progress this week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian airport sale to progress this week.

text.p: The Australian government will probably take the next step in the privatisation of some major airports this week, either announcing winning bidders or a short-list, a source involved in the process said on Tuesday.
The government has already received bids for long leases on the airports -- those at Melbourne, Brisbane and Perth.
The preferred bidders might be announced but the government might instead issue the names of short-listed bidders, the source said.
The tenders were being determined not only on the nominal amounts offered but also on conditions set by the bidders that might affect the value of the bids.
The government was also weighing such factors as the financial strength of the bidders.
Estimates for the proceeds of the airports privatisation are around A$2 billion.
